title: Add up durations
prompt: Read lines from standard input, each holding a duration written `H:MM:SS`: the hours are one to four digits, the minutes and the seconds are exactly two digits and below 60. Spaces at the start and end of a line are ignored; a line that is then empty is skipped silently. For every other line that is not a valid duration print `line N: invalid` immediately, with N the line number counted from 1 over all lines. At the end print `total=HH:MM:SS valid=K`, where the total of all valid durations is written with the hours unlimited and padded with zeros to at least two digits, minutes and seconds with exactly two digits, and K is the number of valid durations.

cases.name: example
cases.expected_output:
line 3: invalid
line 4: invalid
total=04:31:15 valid=3
